title: RequestPermissionParams
description: Asks native code whether a getUserMedia call may proceed. Ineligible requests are sent too, so native code can return them to WebKit when site permissions is off.

capability.description: Native-provided token that authenticates the message; see the feature's `capability` setting.

isEligible.description: Whether the frame passes the page-side checks: secure context, non-opaque origin, and permissions policy.

topOrigin.description: The top-level page's origin, or "null" when the frame can't read it. Native code checks that the request still belongs to the committed top-level page.
